lines.cap: Boston's scariest gangster had a dirty little secret. He was a rat. For the FBI.
lines.say: Boston's scariest gangster had a dirty little secret. He was a rat. For the FBI.

lines.cap: James Whitey Bulger. Boss of the Winter Hill Gang in South Boston. Drugs, extortion, murder.
lines.say: James Whitey Bulger. Boss of the Winter Hill Gang in South Boston. Drugs, extortion, murder.

lines.cap: From 1975, he secretly fed the FBI information. About his rivals, the Italian mafia.
lines.say: From 1975, he secretly fed the FBI information. About his rivals, the Italian mafia.

lines.cap: His FBI handler grew up in the same neighbourhood. He protected Bulger. Tipped him off. Looked away.
lines.say: His FBI handler grew up in the same neighbourhood. He protected Bulger. Tipped him off. Looked away.

lines.cap: So Bulger kept killing. Witnesses. Partners. Anyone who might talk.
lines.say: So Bulger kept killing. Witnesses. Partners. Anyone who might talk.

lines.cap: In 1994, Connolly warned him a charge was coming. Bulger vanished. He spent sixteen years on the FBI's Most Wanted list.
lines.say: In 1994, Connolly warned him a charge was coming. Bulger vanished. He spent sixteen years on the FBI's Most Wanted list.

lines.cap: In 2011, they found him in a quiet apartment in Santa Monica. Eighty one years old. With over eight hundred thousand dollars in the walls.
lines.say: In 2011, they found him in a quiet apartment in Santa Monica. Eighty one years old. With over eight hundred thousand dollars in the walls.

lines.cap: Convicted of eleven murders. In 2018, he was killed in prison, on his first day in a new jail.
lines.say: Convicted of eleven murders. In 2018, he was killed in prison, on his first day in a new jail.
